svg.title: From the car to the audio system
svg.desc: The standard 2010 2.9 has CDR-30 in the centre console, two tweeters on the dashboard and one woofer in each door. The radio aerial supplies reception; vehicle power supplies the output stages. Follow radio or CD information into the head unit, then speaker-driving current from its internal output stages to four drivers. The dashboard and door locations distribute the sound around the two occupants. Numbered parts: 1 CDR-30 head unit; 2 Internal output stages; 3 Right dash tweeter; 4 Right door woofer; 5 Left dash tweeter; 6 Left door woofer; 7 Radio aerial context; 8 Vehicle supply and earth. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
